title: Playwright
description: Cross-browser end-to-end testing for Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

data.text: Playwright is a Node.js library for automating browsers. It supports Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with a single API, making it ideal for cross-browser end-to-end testing.

data.title: Installation
data.code:
npm init playwright@latest
# or
yarn create playwright

data.title: Basic Test
data.content: Write a cross-browser test with Playwright.

terms.definition: An isolated incognito-like session for each test.
Playwright waits for elements to be actionable before acting.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Playwright supports multiple browsers out of the box
It handles dynamic content with auto-waiting
data.takeaway: Playwright is the best choice for robust, cross-browser end-to-end tests.
